notes.title: Quality of Life and a new tile!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks so much for the love this past week. Launch has been great. I've added some new features that I thought would be really cool!

Changes:

[list]
[*] Added screen mode and resolution options
[*] Added Discord and Twitter button (yes I chose the bird icon)
[*] Added a 7% chance of a sword appearing inside the rock object
[*] Added new water object: river corner
[/list]

Fixes:

[list]
[*] Color palette button now has a proper description (translated as well)
[/list]

notes.title: April Fools Update (can be disabled)
notes.content:
Hello Kings & Queens,

It is April Fools today, so I figured to celebrate the 1 week since launch for Le Château, I would make this super cozy experience temporarily a super intense experience; a clicker game. Place buildings like how you always would. But...keep clicking them...because otherwise they will slowly shrink >:)

Enjoy!

(it can be disabled by pressing the enabled button in the bottom left! happy building!)

TheShelfman

notes.title: Build tiny castles in another new relaxing diorama-em-up, out now
notes.content:
I approve of the recent trend towards making building games as relaxing as possible (e.g. Summerhouse). Today sees the release of a new one on Steam, this one a teeny medieval city builder called Le Château that gives you strict limitations for building a castle. You can have a go of the demo for free - I like it a bunch.

Read more

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*]Changed stable default rotation by 90 degrees
[*]Changed default order in which objects is shown
[*]After placing an object, it no longer automatically switches to the next object in line
[*]Added a sound that plays with every tutorial step popup
[*]Tutorial step on rotating the world now requires you to rotate the world twice
[*]When it’s raining, the background is now darker, and there’s a 50% chance that the lighting is also darker

[/list]

[list]
[*]Screenshot button is now also available after build is finished

[/list]

notes.title: Le Château is Feature Complete!
notes.content:
👑Greetings Kings & Queens👑

Exciting news! Le Château is feature complete! Technically it has been for a little while, but I’ve somehow managed to add new stuff to the game consistently.
Stuff like localization for 7 languages, new water tiles, exciting visual upgrades, a chance for a snowy world, birds flying across the screen (I promise they won’t poop all over your castle), and in-game achievements to unlock all the tiles in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831788/344e29e16dda05e156870cc273a3e3a1822a6dda.gif[/img]

I’m super excited to finally share this game with you, but I’m not done yet!
The game still requires more polish, and apparently a whole lot of bugfixing. After the first playtest done by the community, I was confronted with about 20 bugs alone. Some tiny bugs that took a few minutes to fix, others days. I have no doubt there’ll be more bugs to fix still.

Besides that, I still have quite a bit of marketing work to do. About a month for just that would be great.
That said, when oh when can you expect Le Château?👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831788/c01717b03ce0c4d00e90025766214bbc71820451.gif[/img]

Well…I’ll let you know soon. I haven’t 100% decided on a specific date just yet, but it’s not far away now, I promise.

Be sure to follow me on Twitter (@TShelfman), or join my discord to interact with me and the community, or if you got questions😁

Until then, take care!🏰

TheShelfman

notes.title: Le Château on Steam Next Fest - October 9
notes.content:
👑Greetings Kings & Queens👑

Special announcement today! Development has been going strong, and some cool new features have been added, but even better is that SOON™ you'll be able to experience them yourself!

Le Château will be taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest where upcoming games are celebrated by having thousands of demos available to play. This means that Le Chateau will have a demo of its own!
I've been working hard to make it happen (and to see what even works as a demo for a game like this one), and in the end I decided to make it come down to this:

[list]
[*] 1 hour of playtime (it's a lot, I believe, so you should be fine! Infinite just seemed too much for this game)
[*] 2 out of 3 world shapes are available
[*] 20 available tiles (17 of which will have to be unlocked by playing: specifics will be shared through a guide probably)
[/list]

This should all be enough to allow you to make breathtaking kingdoms without feeling restricted to the available features.

I still have some other features in mind to add later, and a bunch of tiles that would be cool to add, but of course that will be for the full version, which I'm hoping to release later this year.

Feel free to ask any questions, I'll gladly answer them!

🏰King Shelfu out (I don't know how I feel about that line but okay)

notes.title: Different world shapes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Something exciting to share about Le Château:
I recently got curious if it would be cool to have more options for world shapes, and the answer was a big [i]yes[/i]!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43831788/de186ced78e6a350d0ca6b42a662d3d274a41f94.gif[/img]
Besides the default square shaped world, I've also added a diamond, and a circle shaped world. 


They size differently than square worlds, since it looks better for them to have a direct middle.
So a square world can size 1, 2, 3, etc all the way to 11. But a diamond or circle world can size 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11.
There's still a lot to do, most of which is trying not to get distracted by other projects, but I'm super excited for people to play this beautiful little cozy city builder.

You can follow more on development on my Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/TShelfman]@TShelfman[/url]

Seeya next time!

[i]TheShelfman[/i]
